Advertisement for recruitment of Office Assistantfor ICMR-Center forAdvance Research
in Reproductive Health (CAR), SMVDU, Katra
Applications are invited on prescribed form attached below (Annexure I) for vacancy of Office Assistant in center sanctioned by Indian Council
of Medical Research (ICMR) on the Project entitled-“To Restraint or Regulate the Reproductive Health Issues of Human from Jammu
and Kashmir Region”(A Multi Institutional Project for the State of Jammu and Kashmir) under the ICMR Notification No. 5/10/15/CAR-
SMVDU/2018-RBMCHand SMVDU vide Notification No.SMVDU/IRDU/18/377.

Terms and condition:
 The post is to be filled up only on purely temporary basis and will be for the duration of the project with continuation being granted every
year based on performance.
 The appointment can be terminated with one-month notice from either side without assigning any reason.
 Since the post is purely temporary, the incumbents selected will have no claim for regular appointments under ICMR or continuation of
his/her services in any other project.
 All appointed staff ensure that the data reaches the central coordinating unit regularly with development of data analysis plan, data
management and analysis and coordinate the disbursement of budget to the centers.
 Benefits of HRA and Travel etc. are only applicable for scientist ‘B’ position.
 No TA/DA etc. will be given to attend Interview or joining of the post and candidate should make his/her own arrangement for stay and
travel.
 Experience will be counted only after completion of essential educational qualification.
 Mere fulfilling the essential qualification does not guarantee selection for the interview call and/or selection.
 Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
 Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department /Organization are not eligible to apply.
 The selected candidate will work in the center mentioned above, and on any other work that may be assigned by the Principal Investigator
from time to time.
 Application must be submitted in the given format (Annexure I) and application in any other format will be rejected.
Date of Interview will be communicated to the eligible candidates through email/phone only and no enquiry in this regard will be
entertained.
Note: The candidates should submit application via email at the email id: icmr.car@smvdu.ac.in. These on-line applications accompanied by
duly signed hard copy along with necessary documents be sent via post so as to reach the Principal Investigator before the last date at
the following address:
Dr. Rakesh Kumar, Assistant Professor, SoBT and PI, ICMR-CAR-SMVDU, Kakryal – 182320, Katra, J&K. On-line
applications alone will not be considered.
Last Date for submitting applications is fifteen days from the date of advertisement published in local newspapers.
Further information on CAR-ICMR-SMVDU and its Mission/Function can be viewed on the SMVDU website (www.smvdu.ac.org)
SMVDU/R&D/21/5359
